title: 🐱 Friendly Cats in Chula Vista Looking for Loving Homes - NewsBreak
text:
2 days ago These sweet cats in Chula Vista, CA are ready to find their forever families. Each one has a unique story and personality — maybe one of them is the perfect match for you!
Bubba Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: Young (almost 2 years)
Gender: Male
Color: Black & White (Tuxedo)
Adoption Fee: $25
Shelter: For Adoption By Private Owner (Chula Vista, CA)
Bubba is a playful tuxedo boy who loves attention but can get a little overstimulated, so he’ll do best with someone experienced with cats. He hasn’t lived with kids before, so a calm, adult home might suit him best.
👉 Meet Bubba and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Cachito Breed: American Shorthair
Age: Adult (6 years)
Gender: Male
Color: Black & White (Tuxedo)
Adoption Fee: $50
Shelter: For Adoption By Private Owner (Chula Vista, CA)
Cachito is a gentle, quiet cat who loves napping by a sunny window. He’s shy at first but very calm once he feels safe. He’d be happiest in a peaceful home where he can relax and be loved.
